accuracy_gap.note: Zero accuracy degradation from INT8 dynamic-range quantisation on the 14-image local test subset. Both models achieve 100% on the available test images; the full 1,100-image evaluation (agent2a) showed 88.0% test accuracy, indicating the local subset is not statistically representative but confirms quantisation does not introduce additional errors on these samples.

ood_detection.note: All 5 OOD inputs went undetected (false-negative rate 100%). The model confidently assigns all synthetic non-plant inputs to class index 2 (Tomato___Late_blight) with top confidence ~0.81-0.84 and entropy ~0.28-0.30, well below the 0.75 threshold. This reveals systematic overconfidence: MobileNetV3 trained solely on PlantVillage maps any structured or unstructured image to the nearest tomato disease class. An entropy-based OOD gate requires a lower threshold (~0.25) or a dedicated OOD detector (energy score, Mahalanobis distance) before production deployment.
